name: very-far-from-origin
covers: integers over 2^24, which a float32 cannot hold exactly

name: wide
covers: a range over 2^24 in every dimension: the 3 integers of an atom are stored one by one, 25 bits each

name: wide-waters
covers: the same with water molecules, so there are runs too

name: wide-x
covers: a range over 2^24 in x only: integers stored one by one with 25, 13 and 1 bits

name: range-30-bits
covers: the widest range GROMACS reads well, 30 bits

name: range-32-bits
covers: a range of 2^30 or more takes 32 bits, which GROMACS reads as 0: all atoms get the minimum x and y

name: waters
covers: water molecules: runs of 2 atoms with the first two atoms interchanged

name: chain
covers: a chain: runs of 8 atoms, the longest

name: mixed
covers: a bit of everything: the run length and the size of the small differences go up and down

name: same-point
covers: all atoms at the same point: sizes of 1 and the smallest small differences

name: plane
covers: all atoms in a plane: a size of 1

name: line
covers: all atoms in a line: two sizes of 1

name: zigzag
covers: consecutive atoms 1.5 nm apart with precision 10^6: small differences and atoms of more than 48 bits

name: sparse
covers: consecutive atoms 10 nm apart with precision 10^6: smallidx is 73, after the end of the table, and atoms have 72 bits

name: sparse-wide
covers: the same 30 nm apart: smallidx 73 and integers stored one by one

name: single-frame
covers: only one frame

name: identical-frames
covers: 4 frames with the same coordinates

name: many-frames
covers: 200 frames of 12 atoms that move a bit, with a box that grows

name: boxes
covers: cubic, rectangular, triclinic, huge, tiny and no box

name: steps-and-times
covers: steps up to the limits of an int32 and times a float32 cannot hold exactly

name: waters-3000
covers: 3000 atoms: bigger frames, to read the file in several pieces
